# 非执行 Tracking Issue

## 原子子 Issue

- [ ] #2694：删除 hand-signed JWT/direct DB/placeholder credentials/legacy strength/permission-duration-refresh compat与 second producer，并建立 consumer inventory。
- [ ] #2695：只消费 #2694 receipt，执行 scanner/mutation/truth-permission-duration-refresh parity/isolation/privacy并签 terminal receipt。

## 实际 DAG

```text
#1713 + #2151 + #2181 + #2182 + #2183 → #2694 → #2695
```

## 原始要求所有权

| Requirement | Owner issue |
|---|---:|
| 删除 hand-signed JWT、Cookie/storage claim修改、direct session/refresh/credential/proof writes、placeholder credentials | #2694 |
| 删除 legacy strength、hardcoded permission/duration、claim-only step-up、old readers/compat/second producer | #2694 |
| Consumer truth eligibility、canonical/bypass/legacy隔离与 secret-safe projections | #2694 实现，#2695 验证 |
| Parent反例/mutations/static scanner、permission/Cookie/refresh parity与 privacy | #2695 |
| Terminal acceptance warnings=0 | #2695 |

## Tracking 完成条件

- [ ] #2694、#2695 completed。
- [ ] Parent/child `Depends on` 与顺序 DAG 一致。
- [ ] 所有 consumers 显式声明 truth class并 exact-one消费 #2182/#2183 verified receipts。
- [ ] Hand-sign/direct DB/placeholder/legacy/permission-duration-refresh compat/second authority残留为0。
- [ ] Canonical/bypass/legacy隔离、consumer parity、privacy通过，`fsusblog.auth-truth-acceptance.v1` warnings=0。

# 原始需求

Parent: #1713
Depends on: #2181, #2182, #2183, #2151

## 原子目标

在 auth truth registry、canonical session variants 与 bypass/legacy isolation完成后，删除 hand-signed JWT、Cookie/storage claims手改、direct session/refresh/credential/proof DB/Redis writes、placeholder credentials、legacy strength/permissions、claim-only step-up、old readers/compat fallback与第二 producer/verifier，并建立终态治理。

## 验收条件

- [ ] 所有 auth consumers显式声明 truth class并消费 verified canonical/bypass/legacy receipts。
- [ ] Hand-signed JWT、direct storage、placeholder credentials、legacy strength/permission map、step-up flag残留为0。
- [ ] Cookie/session duration、refresh/revocation/credential/proof semantics与 production exact。
- [ ] Canonical/bypass/legacy物理逻辑隔离，secret ordinary artifacts泄漏为0。
- [ ] Parent反例与降级实现被 scanner/mutation稳定杀死，terminal receipt current-source、warnings=0。

## 非目标

- 不实现 #2181–#2183或修改 production auth/session/permission/duration policies。
- 不测试完整 login/admin UI。
- 不修复测试发现的产品缺陷。
